entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The Shape view uses the shared normal grid because the source release provides no registered surface imagery. The grid is a coordinate guide, not regolith, measured albedo or an optical photograph.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: SBDB assumed-albedo diameter 38 km
entries.finding: [SBDB assumed-albedo diameter 38 km](https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.api?sstr=944&phys-par=1) — excluded — Its own source note says assumed dark albedo 0.06; an available thermal measurement is stronger evidence.
entries.revisitWhen: New source evidence resolves the recorded calibration or spatial-registration limitation; compare it with the selected product before replacement.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal size 52.45 ± 3.60 km (Usui et al. 2011)
entries.finding: [AKARI thermal size 52.45 ± 3.60 km (Usui et al. 2011)](https://doi.org/10.1093/pasj/63.5.1117) — alternative — Independent infrared-survey result overlaps the adopted WISE uncertainty. Not averaged with a different thermal model/observing geometry.
entries.revisitWhen: New calibration or independent size evidence makes this alternative preferable to the currently adopted, physically compatible scale; do not average incompatible thermal fits.

entries.subject: Ground-based/Spitzer spectrum (Campins et al.)
entries.finding: [Ground-based/Spitzer spectrum (Campins et al.)](https://www-n.oca.eu/thermops/abstract/campins.pdf) — excluded-view — Disk-integrated spectrum, not a registered surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: New source evidence resolves the recorded calibration or spatial-registration limitation; compare it with the selected product before replacement.
